title: We're All Here — title track reel
hook: Twelve songs, one idea: we're all here, so let's mean it.
body:
The We're All Here record is twelve songs about the people in the room and the miles it took to get there. If you've been rocking with the singles, this is the whole thing.

Start with the title track and let it ride.
